hints.title: Definition of Lucky Number
hints.text: A lucky number is the minimum element in its row and the maximum element in its column.

hints.title: Precompute Row Minimums and Column Maximums
hints.text: Find the minimum of each row and the maximum of each column in two passes.

hints.title: Intersection of Properties
hints.text: Iterate through all cells. If matrix[r][c] equals rowMin[r] and colMax[c], append it to the result.
